ops.old: Crisp beer-battered flathead in warm corn tortillas with lime slaw, pickled onion, avocado crema and a hit of hot sauce. Slice 1 red onion and soak in the juice of 2 limes with salt for 20 minutes. Shred a quarter red cabbage and toss with lime juice and coriander. Blitz 1 avocado with 100g sour cream and lime. Whisk 150g plain flour with 250ml cold beer and salt. Cut 600g flathead into strips, dip in batter and fry at 180C for 3 minutes. Warm 12 corn tortillas and fill with fish, slaw, onion, crema and hot sauce.
